title: Normalized braided comparison through a K-flat localization
statement: Let A, B, D and E be braided monoidal categories. Let Q:A→D and L:B→E be lax braided functors, F:A→B a strong braided functor, G:D→E a functor and e:QG≅FL a natural isomorphism. Let W be a morphism property of A containing identities and respecting isomorphisms, and let Q be its localization [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property]. Call an object W-K-flat when tensoring with it on either side preserves W. Suppose the inclusion of W-K-flat objects is a left derivability structure [lem-sfb-multivariable-derived-calculus], every object of D is isomorphic to Q(a) for a W-K-flat a, and the unit comparisons of Q and L are invertible. Suppose μ_Q(a,b) is invertible for every a and W-K-flat b, and μ_L(x,Fb) is invertible for every x in B and W-K-flat b in A. Then G has a strong braided structure satisfying δ_G(Qa,Qb);(e_a⊗e_b);μ_L(Fa,Fb)=G(μ_Q(a,b));e_(a⊗b);L(δ_F(a,b)) for every a,b.

source.place: Tags 06YS and 06YT; the normalized comparison between two left derived tensor bifunctors.

proof.text: Form the mixed counit (e_a tensor e_b) followed by μ_L and the source counit G(μ_Q) followed by e and L(δ_F). They have the same target bifunctor. Both are invertible on pairs whose second factor is W-K-flat. The resolving-subcategory criterion makes both left derived bifunctors. Their unique comparison is a natural isomorphism, normalized by equality of these counits.

The lax-square construction equips G with this oplax comparison; its associator and unit equations hold because they can be checked on resolving models and canceled against the invertible tensorators. The unit and tensor comparison are invertible, giving a strong monoidal structure. The normalization and unit definition make e monoidal. The braided equation for e, F, Q and L proves that of G on resolving models after canceling G(μ_Q). Naturality transports the equation along the model isomorphisms to arbitrary objects.

proof_origin.place: P3 extraction of the two-variable derived universal-property comparison and its coherence.

theorem braidedLocalizationSquare (W : MorphismProperty A)
    [W.ContainsIdentities] [W.RespectsIso] [Q.IsLocalization W]
    [W.localizerMorphismKFlat.IsLeftDerivabilityStructure]
    [IsIso (ε Q)] [IsIso (ε L)]
    (hmodels : ∀ X : D, ∃ a, W.kFlat a ∧ Nonempty (Q.obj a ≅ X))
    (hQ : ∀ a b, W.kFlat b → IsIso (μ Q a b))
    (hL : ∀ (x : B) b, W.kFlat b → IsIso (μ L x (F.obj b))) :
    ∃ b : G.Braided,
      ∀ X Y, b.toMonoidal.toOplaxMonoidal.δ (Q.obj X) (Q.obj Y) ≫
        (e.hom.app X ⊗ₘ e.hom.app Y) ≫ μ L (F.obj X) (F.obj Y) =
      G.map (μ Q X Y) ≫ e.hom.app (X ⊗ Y) ≫ L.map (δ F X Y)
